ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (32) has a matching target block; 3 page marker(s) preserved in place; 8 numbered section(s); attributions: Confucius, A person's worth is measured not by the truth he possesses, but by the labor he has put into acquiring it, Lessing, Suleiman of Granada, Schiller, Amiel, Amiel, Emerson, Manu.
Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (register, omissions, glosses, attribution form).

Schiller's distich keeps its two lines; Amiel's paired terms are kept as pairs (captivity/deliverance, enchantment/disenchantment); «мушкарка» (mushkarka) is 'gnat'; in Emerson «начало» (nachalo) is 'source', and «всё этот свет» (vsyo etot svet) is 'this light is everything'.
